V04 is incorrectly labeled cafeteria/Theo, V05 reception/Ada, V06 service corridor/Eli and Maya carrying a box, V08 east corridor/Nora, V09 service corridor/Eli, and V10 lab absence. Actual images are respectively two gray figures at the service door at 18:14; lab absence at 18:18; a blue figure at the cafeteria at 18:12; a purple figure with a brown box in the loading bay at 18:11; static prototype object reference; and static service-corridor blind-spot maintenance notice.

The timeline invents a probable 18:14-18:18 Maya lab entry referenced to V07 rather than representing the full 18:00-18:18 missing interval. Other staff are dismissed with invented exculpatory image assignments; motive and the service blind spot do not establish Eli's participation.
